key_concepts: Animals can be classified as herbivores, carnivores, or omnivores based on food eaten
Producers such as plants make their own food
Consumers are organisms that eat other organisms
Decomposers break down dead organisms and recycle nutrients
A food chain shows a single path of energy transfer from producers to consumers
A food web is made up of interconnected food chains
Energy in an ecosystem comes from the sun and flows through trophic levels
Energy decreases as it moves up a food chain
Primary, secondary, tertiary, and quaternary consumers occupy successive feeding levels
Removing one organism can disrupt the balance of a food chain or food web
Human activities such as hunting and habitat destruction can affect food chains and food w
Bats can act as pollinators and seed dispersers, supporting forest food chains
